widgets_values:
TRIGGER LAB - animation without keyframes

Queue it: nothing to load, the plate and the light path are built in.
The light sweeps left to right; watch the flare react.

Trigger Showcase has one element per rule (red edge in the editor):
  BORDER gleam  - a warm horizontal gleam that blooms only as the
                  light nears the frame edge, and turns deeper orange
                  the closer it gets.
  CENTER flash  - a dispersed ring that appears as the light crosses
                  the middle, like a torch shone into the lens.
  LIGHT spark   - fires on the distance between the ELEMENT and the
                  light, and rotates 45 deg at full trigger.

Each rule has: mode (border / center / light), what drives it, an
inner..outer range, a falloff, and what it changes - brightness (added,
so an element can sit at 0 and exist only while its rule fires), scale,
rotation and colour.

Twirl any red-edged row open and press 'show' under preview region:
the picker paints the trigger area in red. Drag inner/outer and watch
it resize. Only one rule previews at a time.

Global flicker and edge fade (lens row) are on too - the light fades
out as it leaves frame instead of hanging there forever.
